question: Which of the following teams won the Ranji Trophy 2022 - 23?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Saurashtra**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Ranji Trophy:-**

 
 
• **The Ranji Trophy is a domestic first-class cricket championship played in India.**
 
• **Saurashtra won the Ranji Trophy for the first time in the 2018-19 season and defended their title in the 2019-20 season.**
 
• Hyderabad has won the Ranji Trophy twice in the past, in the 1986-87 and 1987-88 seasons.
 
• Kerala and Bengal have both been runners-up in the Ranji Trophy but have not won the championship yet.
